statement: For rectangle packing SA on AHC001, greedy initialization quality (single-cell vs multi-cell expansion) does not significantly affect final SA score. SA converges to similar quality (~89-90) regardless of init method, given sufficient SA budget (>2.5s).
regime: AHC001 rectangle packing with N<=200, 10000x10000 grid, 3s time limit, SA with valid-by-construction moves
mechanism: SA with max-expansion-bound proposals explores the solution space broadly enough that initial rectangle sizes don't constrain final quality. The landscape is well-connected under single-edge moves, so SA reaches similar basins from different starting points.
applicability_bounds: Holds when SA budget >= 2.5s and N <= 200. May not hold for much larger N where init quality determines which basin SA falls into.
